title: E2E Performance Benchmark Manifest V1
description: Issue #2159 AC1/AC2/AC7: immutable manifest produced by scripts/ci/collect_e2e_performance_benchmark.py for a fixed before/after commit SHA e2e performance benchmark experiment. Each arm's evidence is a cross-run collector output (workflow-run-id-deduped, artifact-ID/digest/head-SHA/job verified) covering the jobs relevant to the pre-split `e2e` job and the post-split `e2e-core` / `e2e-responsive-matrix` jobs. This schema is intentionally immutable-by-convention: a manifest, once verified complete (arms[*].complete == true for all required jobs), must not be silently mutated in place -- a re-run produces a new manifest file (see docs/dev/e2e-performance-benchmark.md).

complete.description: True only if every job's deduped workflow_run_id sample count is >= min_run_count.

topology.description: #2159 P0-4: pre_split (before, monolithic e2e job) vs post_split (after, e2e-core/e2e-responsive-matrix).

run_count.description: Deduped (by workflow_run_id) sample count -- rerun attempts of the same workflow_run_id never add an independent sample (Issue #2159 AC2/P1-1).

workflow_digest.description: #2159 P0-9/AC1: content identity of the workflow definition that produced this run (distinct from the measured-code head_sha).

workflow_sha.description: #2159 OWNER scope-authority ruling (issuecomment-5299412215, item 1/P0-2): the commit SHA of the WORKFLOW DEFINITION that produced this run (`GITHUB_WORKFLOW_SHA`, i.e. the ref the run was dispatched against), distinct from both `head_sha` (the measured application code's commit, checked out via an explicit `actions/checkout` `ref:` override) and `workflow_digest` (a content hash of the workflow file). For a fixed-SHA benchmark dispatch these two SHAs are EXPECTED to differ: `workflow_sha` stays on the current/default branch tip so the workflow's OWN instrumentation logic is current, while `head_sha` pins the OLD/NEW application code being measured.

run_attempt.description: #2179 AC4: the GitHub Actions rerun-attempt number (`GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT`) SELECTED for this sample under `rerun_attempt_selection_policy` -- always 1 under the current `initial_attempt_only_v1` policy (a `workflow_run_id` whose attempt 1 failed/is missing is excluded from the cohort entirely, never substituted with a later attempt). Backward-compatible OPTIONAL field: manifests produced before #2179 omit it.

rerun_attempt_selection_policy.description: #2179 AC3/AC4 (narrowed by #2182 fix_delta hygiene item, OWNER adversarial review issuecomment-5302446086): identifies the deterministic, order-independent policy used to select `run_attempt` for this sample. Restricted to the single currently-recognized policy name -- an unrecognized policy string is never silently accepted as if it were a known policy. Backward-compatible OPTIONAL field: manifests produced before #2179 omit it.
